branches.name: Environment
branches.help: Divine powers over the climate and the land.

branches.name: Resistance
branches.help: Life that endures cold, heat, drought and fire.

branches.name: Sowing
branches.help: More life planted, and spreading on its own.

branches.name: Production
branches.help: Faster growth, richer soil, more oxygen.

branches.name: Shield
branches.help: Softer and rarer crises, at a price.

branches.name: Fauna
branches.help: Animals that thrive, spread and pollinate.

perks.name: Orbital mirrors
perks.help: Unlocks orbital mirrors, which warm the planet.
perks.side_effect: Too much warming overheats life.

story.bought: The Creator gazes at the sky: the Apprentice has built orbital mirrors.
story.refunded: The Apprentice folds the orbital mirrors away into storage.

perks.name: Orbital dust
perks.help: Unlocks orbital dust, which cools the planet.
perks.side_effect: Too much dust triggers an ice age.

story.bought: The Creator squints: the Apprentice has learned to veil the sun with dust.
story.refunded: The Apprentice forgets orbital dust: the sun shines unobstructed.

perks.name: Cloud seeding
perks.help: Unlocks cloud seeding, which brings rain.
perks.side_effect: Rain dries the air: moss and algae suffer.

story.bought: The Creator watches the clouds: the Apprentice has mastered cloud seeding.
story.refunded: The Apprentice forgets how to seed clouds: the sky does as it pleases.

perks.name: Aquifers
perks.help: Unlocks releasing groundwater to the surface.
perks.side_effect: More clouds cool the planet.

story.bought: The Creator listens: the Apprentice has reached the aquifers.
story.refunded: The Apprentice forgets the way to the aquifers: the water-bearing layers fall silent.

perks.name: Awaken volcanoes
perks.help: Unlocks awakening the volcanoes. Requires orbital mirrors.
perks.side_effect: CO₂ stays in the atmosphere for a long time.

story.bought: The Creator scratches their beard: the Apprentice dared to awaken the volcanoes.
story.refunded: The Apprentice forgets how to awaken volcanoes: the mountains sleep peacefully again.

perks.name: Thinning
perks.help: Unlocks thinning a species, which lets light through to lower plants.
perks.side_effect: Fewer plants means less oxygen.

story.bought: The Creator raises a brow: the Apprentice has learned to thin the thickets.
story.refunded: The Apprentice forgets thinning: the thickets grow dense without interference.
